name: Indian Cube Challenge 2017

venue.name: [Primus Public School](http://www.primusschool.com)
venue.address: Primus School, Off. Sarjapur Road, Chikanayakanahalli Village, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560035

information: **Online registration ends on 17th October, 2017. On the spot registration is available. Visit registration and payment tab for details.** If you want to be a full-time volunteer mention it in the "Comment" section during registration. **First time participants** Step 1 - Sign-up on WCA Step 2 - [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IndianCubeChallenge2017/register) for the competition Step 3 - Pay using the details given in the [payments tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IndianCubeChallenge2017#2477-registration-and-payment). **Other participants** Step 1 - Sign-in using your email that you used for your previous competitions Step 2 - [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IndianCubeChallenge2017/register) for the competition (ensure your WCA id is mentioned) Step 3 - Pay using the details given in the [payments tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IndianCubeChallenge2017#2477-registration-and-payment). **Special Prizes** Under-8, under-10 & under-12! First time participants also get special prizes! Leave a WhatsApp message on +91 9052529279 if you have additional queries.
